heading: Press Kit
intro: Everything you need to write about us, in one place. If something you need isn't here, email us and you'll have it the same week.
boilerplate: Burnt Out Games is an independent game studio founded in 2024 by a team of game design students. Its released titles are Burning Out (2025), a four-player co-op horror maze-escape, and Kawai'ian Isolation (2026), a free narrative horror game. The studio's next title is EXO, a third-person speed shooter in development for PC. The team works across genres and builds whichever idea has the most energy behind it.
boilerplateShort: Burnt Out Games is an independent studio making fast, loud, high-energy games. Released: Burning Out and Kawai'ian Isolation. In development: EXO.
usageNote: Writing about us? Everything above is yours to quote. For logos, key art or screenshots at print resolution, email us and we'll send them over the same week.
